concerns.text: Tasks T013 and T031 implement only *temporal* smoothing kernels (4s/8s) as a substitute for spatial smoothing. This silently weakens FR-002 and US-3, which explicitly require 'at least two distinct smoothing kernel sizes' (spatial) to measure the impact of preprocessing choices (SC-003). The plan's 'adaptation' to temporal smoothing is not authorized in the spec; the task deliverable falls short of the FR/SC it claims to satisfy.

Task T008 hardcodes a whitelist of 5 specific dataset IDs (ds000030, ds000248, etc.) and validates against them. This silently narrows FR-001, which mandates downloading data for 'all available paradigms from a curated list of up to 15'. The task scope is restricted to 5 datasets without explicit spec authorization for this reduction, violating the requirement to support the full curated list.

Task T012 implements 'ROI time-series extraction' as a CPU-tractable substitute for fMRIPrep. While the plan notes fMRIPrep is intractable, the spec (FR-002) requires 'fMRIPrep (or equivalent CPU-tractable preprocessing)'. The task does not explicitly define the 'equivalent' nature of this ROI extraction in a way that satisfies the 'standardized configuration' requirement of FR-002, risking a semantic weakening of the preprocessing standard.

Task T049 requires generating a convergence report, but no upstream task (e.g., in T016 or T024) is defined to collect the specific convergence failure data (max iterations, tolerance) required to populate it. This creates a gap where the acceptance criterion for SC-004 (convergence measurement) cannot be met by the task deliverables, effectively dropping the verification step.
